# awscc_ec2_fca_policy (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::EC2::FcaPolicy



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the FCA policy.
- `description` (String) The description of the FCA policy.
- `fca_policy_id` (String) The ID of the FCA policy.
- `instance_fca_policy_document` (Attributes) The FCA policy document for EC2 instance cost allocation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_fca_policy_document))
- `latest_version` (Number) The latest version number of the FCA policy.
- `nat_fca_policy_document` (Attributes) The FCA policy document for NAT gateway cost allocation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nat_fca_policy_document))
- `network_resource_type` (String) The type of network resource the FCA policy applies to.
- `owner_account` (String) The AWS account ID that owns the FCA policy.
- `pcx_fca_policy_document` (Attributes) The FCA policy document for VPC peering connection cost allocation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pcx_fca_policy_document))
- `policy_created_at` (String) The timestamp when the FCA policy was created.
- `show_back_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether show-back reporting is enabled for the FCA policy.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags for the FCA policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `version_expected_effective_at` (String) The timestamp when the latest version of the FCA policy is expected to take effect.

<a id="nestedatt--instance_fca_policy_document"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_fca_policy_document`

Read-Only:

- `cidr_range_specifications` (Attributes) CIDR range specifications, used when the reporting granularity is 'cidr'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_fca_policy_document--cidr_range_specifications))
- `dimensions` (List of String) The cost dimensions to allocate.
- `reporting_granularity` (List of String) The granularity at which costs are reported. Contains exactly one value.

<a id="nestedatt--instance_fca_policy_document--cidr_range_specifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_fca_policy_document.cidr_range_specifications`

Read-Only:

- `prefixes` (Attributes List) The CIDR range to label mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_fca_policy_document--cidr_range_specifications--prefixes))
- `prefixes_type` (String) The type of prefixes the mappings apply to.

<a id="nestedatt--instance_fca_policy_document--cidr_range_specifications--prefixes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_fca_policy_document.cidr_range_specifications.prefixes`

Read-Only:

- `cidr_label` (String) The label for the CIDR range.
- `cidr_range` (String) The CIDR range.
